---
title: "JVM Topics"
description: "Understand JVM concepts through running examples and the Java platform specification."
---

The Java Virtual Machine (JVM) provides the runtime environment for Java bytecode. This section groups JVM-related concepts and their practical implications.

## Topics

- [Java Memory Model (JMM)](jmm/index.qmd) — A **10-part learning tree** based on the Java SE 27 specification, covering visibility, ordering, happens-before, final fields, atomicity, and advanced memory access.

## Planned topics

- Class loading, linking, and initialisation
- JVM runtime data areas
- Heap management and garbage collection
- JIT compilation and runtime optimisation

**Terminology:** The Java Memory Model is defined by the Java Language Specification. It must not be confused with physical JVM runtime memory areas such as the heap and thread stacks.

**Latest specification baseline:** [Java SE 27 — JLS Chapter 17](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se27/html/jls-17.html).
